input: I think the best version of myself shows up when no one is watching. That's when the honesty is real.
Probably when I'm making my morning coffee and there's nobody to perform for. Quiet and unobserved.
On long train journeys. I stare out the window and actually feel the question instead of answering it.
In conversations with people I'll never see again. There's a freedom in that kind of anonymity.
After something goes wrong and I'm sitting with it. Failure is clarifying in a way success never is.
When I'm exhausted. Tiredness strips away the performance layer and what's left is usually the truth.
In writing. I discover what I think by writing it down. It's the only space where I'm not editing as I go.
When I'm angry about something that actually matters. Anger without self-interest is surprisingly rare.
At 3am when I can't sleep and the usual mental noise has quieted down enough to hear something real.
Probably never, fully. But I get closest when I stop trying to be honest and just... am.
